resources.string: Sender name colors in chats are only visible on this device. Chroma cycles the hue; RGB animates a rainbow. Names with bot attribution keep their original style.

For this account: saves cached incoming cloud messages when a remote deletion arrives, plus fully downloaded media. Open files with a compatible viewer. Secret chats and disappearing media are excluded. Previously deleted or unavailable content cannot be recovered. Copies remain until you clear the archive or log out.
